name: fails-code-proves-it

finding.title: `start_server` crashes when the config file is missing
finding.description: `load_config` may return `None` when the file is missing, and then `config["port"]` raises `TypeError` and the server fails to start.

prDiff:
diff --git a/app/server.py b/app/server.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/server.py
+++ b/app/server.py
@@ -40,1 +40,5 @@
 def start_server(path):
+    config = load_config(path)
+    port = config["port"]
+    return bind(port)
+
